What is Amazon Renewed?

Amazon Renewed is your trusted destination for products that are inspected, tested, and refurbished as necessary to be fully functional.

Purchases with an impact

What should I expect to receive with my Amazon Renewed purchase?

Product Description

Up your photography game with the Canon EOS Rebel T7 DSLR Camera with 18-55mm Lens in Black. Perfect for beginners, this camera bundle offers the essential tools you need to take your SLR skills to new heights - all in one convenient package. No matter where your next photography adventure takes you, count on the EOS Rebel T7's impressive 24.1 Megapixel CMOS sensor and wide ISO range of 100 to 6400 (H:12800) to capture high-quality images, even in low-light situations. If you want to share your favorite photos on social media, then that's no problem with the EOS Rebel T7's built-in Wi-Fi and NFC technology, making sharing and uploading photos effortless. This camera also comes equipped with a large LCD display, fast autofocus system, and Full HD video recording for a variety of impressive, easy-to-use features. The Canon EOS Rebel T7 DSLR Camera features a 24.1 Megapixel CMOS (APS-C) sensor with an ISO range of 100-6400 (expandable to 12800). It includes an 18-55mm lens and a 9-point AF system with AI Servo AF for precise focus. The camera has a built-in Wi-Fi and NFC technology for easy sharing, an optical viewfinder with approximately 95 percent viewing coverage, and a 3.0-inch LCD with 920000 dots. Additionally, it offers a Scene Intelligent Auto mode for simplified shooting. This is a renewed product backed by a 90-day warranty.

    • Aiden
      5 out of 5 stars
      Very good beginner camera
      Reviewed in the United States on October 13, 2024
      Style: Standalone
      Verified Purchase
      Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
      Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

      Beginning my photography career I needed a camera that had the most features for the least amount of money, this camera is exactly that. I've used DSLR's in the past but they dont equate to this camera. One of the best qualities, is the battery life. Getting through an hour and a half of shooting (about 300 photos) and still having many more hours left on the battery is impressive. Another strong suite this camera possesses is its 24MP sensor producing sharp images and high compatibility with Canons EF and EF-S lenses.

      The only downsides i've noticed while using this camera is poor low-light function. I notice a lot of noise or grain when the ISO is up past 400, which decreases the photo quality. Additionally, the auto focus seems to fall behind about 15% of the time, which isn't too bad given the price. The last downside is when using the built in flash, after 30 photos, i get a busy icon, restricting me from taking a photo for about 60 seconds which can be frustrating when the models are holding a pose.

      Overall this is a solid camera, and i will continue to buy cannon cameras while progressing into my photography career.

    • A. J. Vance
      4 out of 5 stars
      Great entry point into photography!
      Reviewed in the United States on February 28, 2026
      Style: Standalone
      Verified Purchase
      Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
      Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

      Excellent starter DSLR body. I wasn't ready to commit to the big prices of photography equipment, but getting a T7 has been a perfect entry point. It turns out that good lenses are the real cost of the hobby, but EF-mount lenses compatible with this Rebel are more reasonable than others and they're everywhere!

      My only gripe with this model is the WiFi connectivity. Who knows how old the interface/protocol is, but for 2026 it's slow and inconsistent. I wish it had Bluetooth for easy camera-to-phone sharing, but it does have an NFC and direct WiFi mode. They're just clunky. Using a PC to transfer more than a few photos is recommended. Oh and you'll need a MINI-USB cable for that (like 2 gens of cable connectors ago), so dig one out of your old cord drawer.

      Overall the autofocus and function of the camera has been great. Only 3 shots/second is a little slow, but only shooting sports does that really bug me.

      Reviewed in the United States on January 24, 2026
      Style: Standalone
      Verified Purchase
      Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
      Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

      This camera is everything I hoped it would be. I am very picky when it comes to cameras because at my last job I was using $8k Fujifilms. For the price, this easily satisfies the creative parts of my brain.

      It has customizable settings but it also is super easy to use if you don’t have experience. When I’m lazy I just set everything to auto.

      The quality of its components are notable.

      The zoom quality is great, but the zoom distance leaves room to be desired, however with this model you can purchase additional lenses.

      The batter life is great so far. I’m snowed in currently and have been using it all day without needing to charge.

      All in all, a truly great product!
